motion-duration-xs50msRipple start, color change on small controls.
motion-duration-sm100msHover, press, toggle, checkbox.
motion-duration-md200msTooltip, menu open, expand small content.
motion-duration-lg300msDialog, drawer, bottom sheet enter.
motion-duration-xl400msLarge layout or page transitions.
motion-duration-2xl500msRare: complex choreography.
motion-duration-progress1000msOne turn of a looping progress indicator (spinner). NOT reduced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion — progress indicators are the allowed exception (motion.md).
motion-easing-standard[0.2, 0, 0, 1]
motion-easing-standard-decelerate[0, 0, 0, 1]
motion-easing-standard-accelerate[0.3, 0, 1, 1]
motion-easing-emphasized-decelerate[0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1]
motion-easing-emphasized-accelerate[0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15]
motion-easing-linear[0, 0, 1, 1]
